meta.name: porters-five-forces
meta.description: Read an industry's structure through Porter's Five Forces with documented signals per rating, ending at the profit pool. Use when weighing market entry or when margins erode and nobody can say why.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析行业结构,评估市场进入或利润池变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在进入新市场或利润下滑时系统分析行业竞争格局
copy.tagline_en: Analyze industry structure to evaluate market entry or profit pool shifts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically analyze industry competition when entering a market or facing margin erosion

howto.what: Claude会用波特五力模型分析你指定的行业：先问清行业、决策和地域边界，再逐项评估五种竞争力量并给出弱/中/强评级和带来源的证据，最后指出利润集中在哪、被谁挤压，并给出下一步选项。
howto.when: 当你想评估是否进入某个市场，或发现利润率持续下降却找不到原因时，这个技能会被触发。

say.text: 用波特五力分析一下新能源汽车行业，决策是我们该不该进入。
say.note: 它会先确认细分和地域，然后逐力分析并给出评级和证据。

say.text: 我们的毛利率连续三年下滑，帮我看是不是行业结构造成的。
say.note: 它会从五力角度找结构性的利润挤压点。

say.text: 分析临床数据管理软件市场的五力，支持我们进入还是合作的决策。
say.note: 它会输出带信号评级的五力报告和利润池结论。

howto.what_en: Claude runs Porter's Five Forces on your industry: asks up to 3 questions, rates each force with evidence, ends at the profit pool with next-step options.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you weigh entering a market, or when margins erode and nobody can explain why.

say_en.text: Analyze the EV industry with Five Forces; decision: enter or not?
say_en.note: It will confirm scope, then rate each force with evidence.

say_en.text: Our gross margin keeps falling; give me the structural reason with Five Forces.
say_en.note: It explains which force is squeezing margin structurally.

say_en.text: Run Five Forces on clinical data management software — enter or partner?
say_en.note: Outputs a rated five-forces read and profit-pool conclusion.
